content_of_post_to_answer: Why does fear not disappear despite having so many things in life?
answer: Having many things in life gives you more to value, but also more to lose. Fear doesn't measure how much you have; it often reflects how uncertain you feel about keeping it. Even when life is going well, the mind can imagine losing health, relationships, security, or the future you planned. The paradox is that the more attached we become to life, the more vulnerable we feel. Peace begins not with having nothing to fear, but with accepting that having something precious always involves uncertainty.
